reviews.comment: Lewis leads lectures that foster learning and keep students engaged. The rubrics are clearly laid out for what should be done, and ample opportunities are given to get an A in the class. Well taught and responds to feedback. Best professor to take.

Professor Lewis does a fantastic job of teaching the content, and prepares students very well for completing the group projects that are assigned in the course. She is very accessible outside of class, and cares a lot about her students. I would take her for all of my classes, if I could.

She's an amazing lecturer and pretty funny. I went in with no experience and still managed to get an A. The hw in this class can be challenging, but it gets easier. Quizzes are really hard, but there was a curve for them. The project in this class is fun, but it's really easy to procrastinate, so find a good group to make deadlines a lot easier.
Professor Lewis was very personable and helpful, and the grading was pretty lax.

I guess you don't have to go to class but you're really missing out if you don't. Lewis is an amazing lecturer and I learned so much there. She also cares so much about her students and will give them extra time when things go wrong or extra help. I hope I have her again.
Dr. Lewis is the goat; super fun and easy class.
Dr. Lewis is the goat. Super fun and easy class.

Fairly easy class, prof Lewis is very nice and was very helpful. The homework is challenging at first, but gets easier as experience builds. The semester long project was a pain however and the deadlines always seemed to come up out of nowhere; make sure you have a great group to ease the stress.

Dr. Lewis is an amazing lecturer and truly cares about her students. She takes an interest in personal projects and will keep in touch after the semester ends. Hw's can be challenging sometimes but she is very helpful with questions. Don't put off the projects!! This class is super fun and an easy A as long as you turn everything in on time.

A very reliable prof, is very understanding and cares about her student's success. Her lectures are very good and she runs you through solid works pretty well. The midterm quiz is quite easy, just make sure you know how to do the stuff practiced in class. The homework is hard at first but once you get used to solidworks they are not bad at all.

Dr.Lewis is an amazing professors that truly cares about her students. I often went to her office hours for help on homework assignments and she explained everything step by step until I understood what I was doing wrong. If you complete the home and class assignment on time and don't procrastinate on the project, an A is easy to get.

Lewis is a great prof! I have previous experience with autodesk inventor, which made this class really easy for me, but even with no previous CAD experience this class should not be extremely hard if you care about the class. The semester-long group project was fun. Do the homeworks, they helped massively in understanding Solidworks features.

Lewis was great! I had no previous experience with SolidWorks but she made the class easier and enjoyable. Home assignments are a little tough but manageable. Highly recommend taking her class if you can.

Very nice person, content was interesting. Home assignments challenging but help you learn. Con: Slow feedback. Class assignments simple but make attendance semi-mandatory. Group project is also heavily weighted so pick good people. "Quiz" worth 10% is relatively simple if you have paid attention, 20 points of bonus. Fun course and caring prof.

Not the best class to take as an 8 am, but 210 with Lewis went smoothly. It took several weeks to get any feedback back on my assignments, but once I got the hang of Solidworks it was a breeze. You'll get really good at drawing circles and lines!

Professor Lewis was always a joy to talk to and her lectures were very informative. I had zero experience with SolidWorks before this class and made the rookie mistake of not recognizing what a fully defined sketch was. I submitted around half a dozen assignments before I got any feedback to recognize my mistake. Beyond that, I have no gripes.

A big factor in the difficulty of this class is previous experience with SolidWorks. That said, Professor Lewis is always reachable and has very useful office hours. There is a big group project in the class that takes all semester to complete and she makes all the instructions clear. Besides that, she shares very useful professional experience.

Attendance is only mandatory because there are in-class assignments for most lectures. The TAs grade all of the 3D models, and some of them grade them tougher than others. This class isn't that difficult as long as you complete all the work and try to avoid stupid mistakes on the modeling such as undefined sketches, which they'll explain.

Dr. Lewis was an amazing professor and taught me a lot about SolidWorks. There were weekly class assignments that we did together and homework we did on our own. The homework was challenging, but it is standardized for the curriculum. Do not fall behind on the group project though!

Professor Lewis is an excellent teacher. She explains material clearly and relates it to her own work experience, making the content more relevant. The class itself is fun, but lots of work, so dont procrastinate and if you have to 3D print for the semester project, DO IT FAR IN ADVANCE!!!!

This class was about SolidWorks and the general design process Mrs. Lewis has a lot of experience to share from industry and knows how to give good feedback on just about anything. She goes a bit fast on the in-class SolidWorks tutorials so try to keep up. An easy class, but you learn a lot.

Professor Lewis explained concepts clearly in class. Her ties to industry allowed her to really explain how the concepts taught in class apply to the real world. Her office hours are very helpful. The semester-long project can be pretty tedious, but Professor Lewis was willing to help anytime we had a problem.

Loved this class! Her lectures are amazing and she is an extremely personable and caring prof. As someone who had never used Solidworks, I was nervous but she was always open to questions and explained everything very well. There was a lot of work outside of class but that is expected when grades are determined solely through homework and projects.
She is alright. She goes through her PowerPoints pretty quickly. If you've got no experience with SolidWorks or another similar program, Youtube is useful.

Professor Lewis explains the material very clearly. She has a list of grading criteria for each assignment that is easy to follow. Always available for office hours and super friendly! I would take her class again because she is very easy to learn from. SOLIDWORKS is taught, which is hard, but she teaches it very well for a required class.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures--Would take again
